statusDetail: External access control blocked the requested GST Returns application: navigation to /returns/auth/dashboard returned HTTP 403 and browser navigation ended on services.gst.gov.in/services/error/accessdenied. This is a partial atomic report, not a completed audit.

page.notes: The target application could not be profiled. The reachable page is a GST Access Denied error surface with legacy Angular-related CSS, but it is not treated as representative of the requested application.
